title: You Can Start This $1M/Yr Business With No Tools and No Crew

idea.name: Cozy Pros home-performance contracting
idea.one_liner: Sell homeowners attic insulation removal and replacement, air sealing, and duct sealing, using inspections and subcontracted crews to deliver the work.
idea.customer: Homeowners, especially those with uncomfortable, leaky or poorly insulated homes.
idea.offer: A home inspection followed by a tailored package of attic sealing, insulation and duct services.
idea.revenue_model: Home-improvement project tickets, with add-on services and financing.

key_quotes.quote: Using the subcontractor model, you can make over a million dollars a year of net profit.
So, help people understand how their house is leaky and how we do it up nice and tight and save them.

And the fastest way in this business to cash flow and to start making some good healthy profits is to subcontract it.
So, we'll do like a free attic inspection.

idea.name: Air-scrubber installation and replacement cells
idea.one_liner: Install air scrubbers in homeowners' HVAC systems and sell replacement cells periodically.
idea.customer: Homeowners concerned about dust, allergens, asthma or viruses.
idea.offer: Install an air scrubber in the supply or return side of an AC system, then offer replacement cells.
idea.revenue_model: One-time installation sale plus replacement-cell sales every few years.

ideas.delivery: A technician fits the device into the HVAC plenum, seals it and connects power. The transcript says homeowners with basic low-voltage knowledge could also install it.
